mapper.select: SELECT p.tenant_id,p.project_id,p.policy_id,p.version_id,p.author_record_id,p.fixed_json,p.content_sha256, r.content_sha256 AS registry_hash,r.entity_kind AS registry_kind,p.schema_version,p.schema_manifest_sha256,p.created_by,p.created_at,p.classification FROM agent_execution_policy_version p JOIN version_registry r ON r.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND r.version_id=p.version_id AND r.owner_project_id <=> p.project_id WHERE p.version_id=#{versionId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT s.tenant_id,s.project_id,s.policy_id,s.version_id,s.status,s.revision,s.latest_decision_id,s.updated_at FROM agent_execution_policy_state s JOIN agent_execution_policy_version p ON p.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND p.project_key=s.project_key AND p.policy_id=s.policy_id AND p.version_id=s.version_id AND p.content_sha256=s.content_sha256 AND p.schema_version=s.schema_version AND p.schema_manifest_sha256=s.schema_manifest_sha256 AND p.created_by=s.created_by AND p.created_at=s.created_at AND p.classification=s.classification WHERE s.version_id=#{versionId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT c.tenant_id,c.project_id,c.policy_id,c.version_id,c.component_id,c.kind,c.content_json,c.content_sha256, r.content_sha256 AS registry_hash,r.entity_kind AS registry_kind,c.schema_version,c.schema_manifest_sha256,c.created_by,c.created_at,c.classification FROM agent_execution_policy_component c JOIN agent_execution_policy_version p ON p.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND p.project_key=c.project_key AND p.policy_id=c.policy_id AND p.version_id=c.version_id AND p.content_sha256=c.policy_sha256 JOIN version_registry r ON r.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND r.version_id=c.component_id AND r.owner_project_id <=> c.project_id WHERE c.version_id=#{versionId} ORDER BY c.component_id

SELECT d.tenant_id,d.project_id,d.policy_id,d.version_id,d.decision_record_id,d.content_sha256,d.decision_json,d.decision_sha256, d.decision,d.status,d.before_revision,d.after_revision,d.created_by,d.created_at,d.schema_version,d.schema_manifest_sha256,d.classification FROM agent_execution_policy_decision d WHERE d.version_id=#{versionId} ORDER BY d.after_revision
SELECT CONCAT(e.relation_kind,':',e.upstream_version_id) FROM lineage_edge e WHERE e.consumer_version_id=#{versionId} ORDER BY e.upstream_version_id,e.relation_kind
SELECT CONCAT(e.relation_kind,':',e.upstream_version_id) FROM lineage_edge e WHERE e.consumer_version_id=#{versionId} ORDER BY e.upstream_version_id,e.relation_kind

SELECT v.source_version AS version_id,v.original_sha256 AS content_sha256,r.entity_kind,s.owner_project_id AS project_id,s.source_id AS resource_id, 'SOURCE' AS kind,NULL AS status,NULL AS execution_mode FROM source_version v JOIN source s ON s.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND s.source_id=v.source_id JOIN version_registry r ON r.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND r.version_id=v.source_version AND r.content_sha256=v.original_sha256 AND r.owner_project_id <=> s.owner_project_id WHERE v.source_version=#{versionId}

SELECT c.capability_version AS version_id,c.content_sha256,r.entity_kind,c.project_id,c.config_id AS resource_id,c.kind, CASE WHEN h.status='DISABLED' THEN 'DISABLED' ELSE c.status END AS status,NULL AS execution_mode FROM capability_version c JOIN configuration_head h ON h.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND h.project_key=c.project_key AND h.config_id=c.config_id AND h.kind=c.configuration_kind JOIN version_registry r ON r.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND r.version_id=c.capability_version AND r.content_sha256=c.content_sha256 AND r.owner_project_id <=> c.project_id WHERE c.capability_version=#{versionId}

SELECT c.model_config_revision AS version_id,c.content_sha256,r.entity_kind,c.project_id,c.config_id AS resource_id,'MODEL' AS kind, CASE WHEN h.status='DISABLED' THEN 'DISABLED' ELSE c.status END AS status,c.execution_mode FROM model_config_revision c JOIN configuration_head h ON h.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND h.project_key=c.project_key AND h.config_id=c.config_id AND h.kind=c.configuration_kind JOIN version_registry r ON r.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND r.version_id=c.model_config_revision AND r.content_sha256=c.content_sha256 AND r.owner_project_id <=> c.project_id WHERE c.model_config_revision=#{versionId}
SELECT p.version_id FROM agent_execution_policy_version p WHERE (p.project_id <=> #{projectId} OR p.project_id IS NULL) AND p.version_id > #{afterId} ORDER BY p.version_id LIMIT #{scanLimit}
mapper.update: UPDATE tenant SET governance_epoch=governance_epoch+1 WHERE auth_epoch=#{authEpoch} AND governance_epoch=#{governanceEpoch}
